title: OA TREASURE - the Modifications to Standard Magical Items: the occidental items rule and the form changes
audit_label: R738 OA standard item mods audit
audit_comment: OA round one hundred twenty-five (capture p. 286): the Modifications to Standard Magical Items prose - the occidental items rule with the gajin, curiosity, and caster sources, the form changes of the lyre, cloak, boots, and bags, the DM form decision leaving function untouched, the capture misreads pinned against the print, single-pass pins per the Chapter 9 provenance shift

consts.name: dkzGajinThreshold
consts.comment: the gajin count - the three sources of an item appearing as printed in the DMG in an Oriental setting: the gajin bringing it in, the import as a curiosity, the inspired or deranged spell caster assembling it (print capture p. 286)

consts.name: dkzFormChangeCount
consts.comment: the form change count - the four examples of the occidental form taking an Oriental shape: the lyre, cloak, boots, and bags (print capture p. 286)

bools.name: dkzMajorityAvailable
bools.comment: the majority - most of the DMG magical items available throughout the world of the Orient (print capture p. 286)

bools.name: dkzSomeParticularlyOccidental
bools.comment: the exceptions - some items particularly occidental (print capture p. 286)

bools.name: dkzDoNotAppearNormally
bools.comment: the appearance rule - the occidental items do not appear normally in the Oriental world (print capture p. 286)

bools.name: dkzOrSomewhatDifferent
bools.comment: the difference rule - if they do appear, they are somewhat different from those listed in the DMG (print capture p. 286)

bools.name: dkzLittleOrNoUse
bools.comment: the use clause - there may be little or no use for the items in the Oriental setting (print capture p. 286)

bools.name: dkzNotWithinCulture
bools.comment: the culture clause - they may not be items found within the culture (print capture p. 286)

bools.name: dkzNotToSayCannotAppear
bools.comment: the allowance - this is not to say they cannot appear (print capture p. 286)

bools.name: dkzConstructionFarFromCommon
bools.comment: the commonness - only that their construction and use is far from common (print capture p. 286)

bools.name: dkzGeneralRuleIfAsPresented
bools.comment: the general rule - if any of the items below appear as presented in the DMG in an Oriental setting (print capture p. 286)

bools.name: dkzBroughtInByGajin
bools.comment: the gajin source - brought in by gajin, the capture misreading the gaijin (print capture p. 286)

bools.name: dkzImportedAsCuriosities
bools.comment: the import source - imported as curiosities (print capture p. 286)

bools.name: dkzAssembledByInspiredCaster
bools.comment: the caster source - assembled by some inspired or deranged spell caster (print capture p. 286)

bools.name: dkzGenerallyOccidentalForm
bools.comment: the form - the DMG items generally, although not always, occidental in form and function (print capture p. 286)

bools.name: dkzLyreSamisenOrFlute
bools.comment: the lyre example - a known instrument in occidental lands taking the form of a samisen or flute in the Orient (print capture p. 286)

bools.name: dkzCloakRobeOrJacket
bools.comment: the cloak example - a cloak becoming a robe or jacket (print capture p. 286)

bools.name: dkzBootsSandals
bools.comment: the boots example - boots becoming sandals (print capture p. 286)

bools.name: dkzBagsBoxes
bools.comment: the bags example - bags becoming boxes (print capture p. 286)

bools.name: dkzDMDecidesForm
bools.comment: the decision - it is the DM's decision to alter the form of any item, the capture misreading after for the alter (print capture p. 286)

bools.name: dkzFunctionUnaffected
bools.comment: the function clause - this does not affect the function of the item in any way (print capture p. 286)

examples.note: the first paragraph - the occidental items rule, healthy values, each condition false
examples.expr: m['dkzMajorityAvailable']() != 1 or m['dkzSomeParticularlyOccidental']() != 1 or m['dkzDoNotAppearNormally']() != 1 or m['dkzOrSomewhatDifferent']() != 1 or m['dkzLittleOrNoUse']() != 1 or m['dkzNotWithinCulture']() != 1 or m['dkzNotToSayCannotAppear']() != 1 or m['dkzConstructionFarFromCommon']() != 1

examples.note: the three sources - the gajin, the curiosity, and the caster, healthy values, each condition false
examples.expr: m['dkzGeneralRuleIfAsPresented']() != 1 or m['dkzBroughtInByGajin']() != 1 or m['dkzImportedAsCuriosities']() != 1 or m['dkzAssembledByInspiredCaster']() != 1 or m['dkzGajinThreshold']() != 3

examples.note: the second paragraph - the form changes and the function clause, healthy values, each condition false
examples.expr: m['dkzGenerallyOccidentalForm']() != 1 or m['dkzLyreSamisenOrFlute']() != 1 or m['dkzCloakRobeOrJacket']() != 1 or m['dkzBootsSandals']() != 1 or m['dkzBagsBoxes']() != 1 or m['dkzDMDecidesForm']() != 1 or m['dkzFunctionUnaffected']() != 1 or m['dkzFormChangeCount']() != 4
